reviews.text: They did a great job on our pool, we got new coping, tile and plaster.  It turned out amazing, they were prompt and did the work very quickly and coordinated.  The finished product was amazing.  They also were the low bid I received, I would highly recommend them.

reviews.text: They did a great job on our pool plaster.  Would definitely recommend.

data.summary: The reviews show some authentic signals but raise significant concerns. The perfect 5.0 rating with only 5 generic reviews, combined with complete absence on other platforms, suggests either a very new/small operation or potential review manipulation. The BBB A+ rating without any customer reviews or complaints is unusual. While not definitively fake, the pattern warrants caution.
fake_signals: All 5 Google reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback
Reviews are generic and lack specific project details (no dates, crew names, specific materials)
Multiple reviews use similar vague praise language ('amazing', 'great job')
Low review volume (5) for a 4-year-old contractor suggests limited customer base or selective review collection
No reviews on any other consumer platforms despite being in business since 2021
authentic_signals: Some reviews mention specific services (re-plastering, coping, tile)
Two reviews mention a contact person (Gustavo)
Reviews span different time periods (2 years ago to 2 months ago)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Perfect 5.0 Google rating with only 5 reviews, but no reviews on other major platforms (Yelp, Angi, Houzz). BBB has an A+ rating but no customer reviews or complaint data, which is unusual for a 4-year-old business.
